Let’s Make Something Memorable…

"There are no rules in filmmaking. Only sins. And the cardinal sin is dullness."

-Frank Capra

Have an idea you're ready to execute? Or a blank page you're ready to fill? We can help you tell your story. Whether we're editing your existing assets or creating a fresh library of powerful images and cinematic b-roll, our process is fast and efficient. No budget for a full shoot? No problem—we can use generative AI to create incredible visuals from thin air. A partnership with Studio-Blink is a streamlined way to get a powerful, scroll-stopping ad running in just a couple of days.

What can Studio-Blink do to help tell YOUR story?

IDEATION

Finding the seed of a compelling story can be the most difficult part of the creative journey. Some people have a green thumb for gardening, or a knack for cooking, we like to craft narratives. Let Studio-Blink be your ultimate brainstorming partner.

IMAGING

Visual Storytelling. It’s right there in the name. We are going to need some images. We now have more options for high quality image creation than ever before. Cinematic cameras, drones, and now Generative AI - imaging has never looked better.

EDITING

Ok… we have our idea. We have our amazing images. Now let’s put it all together. Whether crafting an eye-popping website banner ad, or eliciting laughs and tears with a compelling commercial - the edit is where our project will come to life.

Meet the Founder

Eric Parker Andersen

On our Team, there is no I … but plenty of AI

When you partner with Studio-Blink, you're working directly with a single creative dedicated to your vision. This streamlined approach means clients get a direct line to the person doing the work, avoiding the confusing layers of a large agency. For larger productions, Studio-Blink leverages a trusted network of collaborators and cutting-edge AI tools. This flexible model allows the team to deliver the power of a full-scale production with the efficiency and cost savings of a lean operation. The old rules of production are a thing of the past; Studio-Blink delivers high-quality work with incredible speed and savings.

Eric Parker Andersen, founder of Studio-Blink, inc., has been captivated by the power of moving images for as long as he can remember. His journey began with backyard VHS blockbusters and led to a decades-long career that’s included television news, travel shows, and even the video game industry. Throughout it all, he's had the incredible fortune to collaborate with a wide range of exciting brands and personalities. This diverse experience is the foundation of Studio-Blink's approach to storytelling.
